evidence.title: Stopped Grandfather Clock
evidence.description: The pendulum hangs still; the hands read half past nine and seventeen minutes.

evidence.title: Open Wall Safe
evidence.description: The safe hangs open. The diamond is gone.

evidence.title: Undamaged Safe Lock
evidence.description: A close look at the lock: no scratches, no force. It was opened with a key.

evidence.title: Spare Key in Bob's Coat
evidence.description: In the pocket of Bob's coat: a spare safe key, still warm from his hand.

evidence.title: Torn Debt Letter
evidence.description: A moneylender's letter, torn in quarters: Bob owes Lennox more than he can ever repay.

evidence.title: Muddy Footprints
evidence.description: Fresh field-mud prints cross the study rug to the door and back.

evidence.title: Theo's Field Boots
evidence.description: Caked in the same field mud as the study prints; the tread matches exactly.

evidence.title: Mara's Testimony
evidence.description: Mara admits she saw Bob near the study at the time the clock stopped.
evidence.note: Testimony, not objective truth: the source is recorded and it only feeds rules alongside other facts.

evidence.title: Theo's Alibi Claim
evidence.description: Theo insists he was in the garden all evening and never went inside.
evidence.note: A claim, not a fact about the world: only usable via the alibi-contradiction rule.

evidence.title: Bob's Alibi Claim
evidence.description: Bob claims he spent the whole evening in the library.
evidence.note: A claim, not a fact about the world: only usable via the alibi-contradiction rule.
